title: Rényi-regularized mixture VI on a bimodal calibration twin
setting: A two-parameter twin experiment with forward model G(theta)=(theta1^2, theta2), a Gaussian prior and Gaussian observation noise, so the posterior has a sign-symmetric pair of modes in theta1 whose separation is set by the true theta1. A 2-component Gaussian mixture is fitted by Adam from 8 random restarts per run, minimizing expected Tikhonov loss minus entropy, optionally plus a sampled Rényi divergence D_alpha(prior||q). The metric is the fraction of restarts that put less than 10% of q's mass on the minority half (theta1 sign) of the posterior, measured against a 2D grid ground-truth posterior.

paper.title: Rènyi-Regularized Flow-Based Variational Inference for Bayesian Calibration
paper.claim: A Rényi-divergence regularizer toward the prior reduces near-collapse onto one mode of a well-separated bimodal posterior, at some cost in approximation accuracy.

metric.name: collapse_frac
metric.description: Fraction of the 8 restarts in which the fitted mixture places less than 10% of its mass on the minority mode (theta1 sign) of the grid posterior. Diagnostics: mode_mass_err (|q mass on theta1>0 minus truth|), sym_kl (symmetric KL to grid posterior), mean_minority_mass, true_minority_mass.

factors.name: method
factors.description: kl: expected Tikhonov minus entropy (standard VI objective). renyi: same plus lambda=1 times the Rényi divergence D_alpha(prior||q) estimated from samples.

factors.name: separation
factors.description: True theta1 (modes at +/- this value); larger means better-separated modes.

factors.name: noise
factors.description: Observation noise standard deviation; affects how sharply the modes are defined.

factors.name: alpha
factors.description: Rényi order used by the regularizer (no effect for the kl method).
